a.text: Researchers fitted tiny tags to honeybees from a single hive and recorded every trip the bees made over one summer. Most foraging happened in the morning, but a small group of bees kept leaving the hive after dark, which surprised the team. Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
choices: The bees forage only in the morning.
Some bees in the hive also forage after dark.
The hive was moved during the summer.
a.answer: Some bees in the hive also forage after dark.

b.text: Researchers fitted tiny tags to honeybees from a single hive and recorded every trip the bees made over one summer. Most foraging happened in the morning, but a small group of bees kept leaving the hive after dark, which surprised the team. According to the text, why did the researchers track the bees at night?
choices: The bees forage only in the morning.
Some bees in the hive also forage after dark.
The hive was moved during the summer.
b.answer: Some bees in the hive also forage after dark.
